ask: Write me a week of LinkedIn posts about hiring.

posts.content: Post 1 text, written in the brand's voice.

steps.why: One call for the whole week, every item a Draft with its accounts. Never a loop of create-post. If the call asks for text items, send each object JSON-encoded.
Poll until status is completed, whatever the reply's text says. Its posts are the real saved rows; report rejected and quality_blocked.

say: Saved to Acme as drafts. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule all 5? Or tell me what to change. Bolta picks exact times from your posting schedule.
never: A scheduled_time or requested_action on any item.
More than 12 posts in a sitting.
